card.title: Marketing Head

detail.rawHtml:
Job highlights
  • 15 years experience in automobile sales and marketing, expertise in dealer network development and strategic sales planning
  • Drive sales growth, develop and implement sales strategies, manage dealer networks, lead marketing campaigns, oversee customer relationship management, and coordinate cross-functional teams

Job description

Marketing Head Sales (Automobile Industry)

Job Summary

A dynamic and results-oriented Marketing Head Sales with 15 years of experience in the automobile industry, responsible for driving sales growth, expanding market presence, strengthening dealer networks, and leading integrated marketing initiatives. The role focuses on developing business strategies, enhancing customer experience, achieving revenue targets, and ensuring sustainable profitability across passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, electric vehicles, or automotive components.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy & Business Growth

  • Develop and implement annual and long-term sales strategies to achieve revenue and market share objectives.
  • Identify new business opportunities, emerging markets, and customer segments.
  • Drive retail, institutional, fleet, and corporate sales to maximize business growth.
  • Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
  • Develop pricing and promotional strategies in coordination with senior management.

Dealer & Channel Management

  • Build, expand, and strengthen dealer and distributor networks across assigned territories.
  • Monitor dealer performance and profitability through regular reviews and audits.
  • Develop dealer incentive programs to improve sales productivity and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure dealership compliance with company standards for sales, branding, and customer service.
  • Support dealer development, training, and business planning initiatives.

Marketing & Brand Management

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across print, digital, outdoor, television, and social media platforms.
  • Plan and manage vehicle launches, dealership inaugurations, roadshows, exhibitions, and promotional events.
  • Strengthen brand positioning and improve market visibility through targeted marketing initiatives.
  • Manage advertising agencies, media partners, and promotional vendors.
  • Analyze campaign performance and optimize marketing ROI.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Enhance customer acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies.
  • Improve customer satisfaction by monitoring sales and after-sales service quality.
  • Implement CRM initiatives to strengthen customer loyalty and increase repeat business.
  • Address key customer concerns and ensure timely resolution.

Market Intelligence

  • Conduct market research on industry trends, competitor activities, pricing, and consumer preferences.
  • Identify opportunities in electric vehicles (EVs), commercial vehicles, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Recommend business strategies based on market intelligence and data analysis.

Financial & Commercial Management

  • Prepare annual sales forecasts, marketing budgets, and business plans.
  • Monitor sales profitability, margins, and operational costs.
  • Ensure efficient utilization of marketing budgets and maximize return on investment.
  • Negotiate commercial agreements with fleet customers, government organizations, and corporate clients.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop regional sales managers, area managers, and marketing teams.
  • Define KPIs and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Foster a high-performance, customer-focused, and results-driven work culture.
  • Identify training needs and implement leadership development programs.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with production, supply chain, finance, product development, and after-sales service teams to ensure product availability and successful market execution.
  • Support demand forecasting and inventory planning to optimize vehicle availability.
  • Work closely with service teams to improve customer experience and strengthen brand loyalty.

Reporting & Compliance

  • Prepare and present sales performance reports, market analysis, and strategic business reviews to senior leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, automotive industry regulations, and ethical business practices.
  • Represent the organization at automotive expos, dealer conferences, and industry forums.

Key Skills

  • Automotive Sales & Marketing
  • Dealer Network Development & Management
  • Business Development
  • Strategic Sales Planning
  • Fleet & Institutional Sales
  • Brand Management
  • Product Launch Management
  • Market Research & Competitive Analysis
  • CRM & Customer Retention
  • Budgeting & Sales Forecasting
  • P&L Management
  • Contract Negotiation
  • Digital Marketing
  • Team Leadership & Performance Management
  • Data Analytics & Sales Reporting

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of sales and revenue targets
  • Market share growth
  • Dealer network expansion and productivity
  • Customer satisfaction (CSI/NPS)
  • Marketing campaign ROI
  • Retail and wholesale sales growth
  • Fleet and institutional business growth
  • Dealer profitability and compliance
  • Customer retention and repeat purchases
  • Profit margin improvement
